description: Implement session memory (latestAnalysisContext) in the frontend for natural follow-up conversations, fix empty red warning boxes in AI output, add follow-up chat behavior that uses stored context, and make the UI feel more like ChatGPT/Claude with smooth follow-up flow.
steps: STEP 1 - Expand latestAnalysisContext (around line 919 in index.html) to store full analysis context. New structure: { ticker, companyName, score, decision, keyLevels: { support, resistance, entry, stopLoss, target }, risks: [], actionPlan: [], evidenceLevel, fcaStatus, brokerSummaryProvided, brokerSummaryBias, brokerSummaryStrength, brokerSummaryPeriods: [], lastAnalysisHtml: null (store summary text only, NOT full html), lastAnalysisTimestamp }. Update resetBrokerSummaryContext to reset all fields.

STEP 2 - After each successful analysis response (in handleAnalysis and handleChartUpload), parse the AI response HTML to extract key context. Add a function extractAnalysisContext(html) that uses regex/DOM parsing to extract: score (from text like 'xx/70' or 'xx/55'), decision label (from known labels list), key levels (support/resistance numbers), ticker. Store extracted data in latestAnalysisContext. Do NOT store the full HTML - just structured data. Keep it under 2KB to avoid localStorage bloat.

STEP 3 - Update handleChat function (around line 1340 in index.html) to pass latestAnalysisContext as a 'context' field in the API request body when source is 'chat_mode' or 'follow_up'. Build a concise context string: 'Ticker: X, Score: Y/Z, Decision: LABEL, Support: A, Resistance: B, Risks: [...]'. Only include fields that have values. This enables the AI to answer follow-ups without re-asking for data.

STEP 4 - Add a new request source 'follow_up' in handleChat. Detect when user is asking a follow-up about the last analysis (regex: /gimana|bagaimana|kenapa|why|lanjut|terus|kalau|apa.*berikutnya|masuk.*gak|beli|jual|hold|cut/i AND latestAnalysisContext.ticker exists). When detected, use source 'follow_up' instead of 'chat_mode'. This tells the API to use the compact follow-up prompt.

STEP 5 - Fix empty red warning boxes. After each AI response is inserted into the DOM (in addAIBubble function), add a post-processing step: find all elements with classes containing 'border-red' or 'bg-red' or 'text-red-400' that have empty or whitespace-only text content, and hide them (display:none). Also hide any div that contains only 'Tidak tersedia' or 'Belum bisa dikonfirmasi' as its sole content. Add function: hideEmptySections(bubbleElement).

STEP 6 - Fix empty 'Final Note' display. In the hideEmptySections function, also target any h3/heading containing 'Final Note' where the sibling content area is empty or contains only generic disclaimers that are already said elsewhere. If a section's meaningful content (excluding the heading) is less than 20 characters, hide the entire section card.

STEP 7 - Update saveChatHistory to also save latestAnalysisContext in the session object (already partially done - verify it saves the expanded context). When switching sessions via switchSession, restore latestAnalysisContext from the session. This enables follow-up conversations to work even after switching sessions.

STEP 8 - Add visual indicator in the composer area when context is available. When latestAnalysisContext.ticker exists, show a small subtle tag below the input: '<ticker> context active' in emerald-400 text. This helps users know they can ask follow-up questions. Hide it when no analysis has been done in the current session.
acceptance_criteria: latestAnalysisContext stores ticker, score, decision, keyLevels after each analysis
Follow-up chat requests include context field with structured analysis data
Follow-up detection works for common Indonesian follow-up phrases
Empty warning boxes (red border with no content) are hidden after AI response renders
Empty Final Note sections are hidden
Context indicator shows below input when analysis context is available
No base64 or full HTML stored in latestAnalysisContext
All inline JS passes syntax validation
verification: unset NODE_OPTIONS && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readFileSync('/projects/sandbox/auto-cuan/index.html','utf8'); if(!html.includes('extractAnalysisContext')) throw 'Missing context extraction'; if(!html.includes('hideEmptySections')) throw 'Missing empty section hiding'; if(!html.includes('follow_up')) throw 'Missing follow-up source'; console.log('FEAT-002 checks passed');"
findings: Implemented all 8 steps. index.html grew from 2027 to 2201 lines. extractAnalysisContext uses regex on HTML string to pull score, decision, key levels, risks, and action plan. hideEmptySections handles border-red-500, bg-red-500 empties, 'Tidak tersedia' text, and short Final Note sections. Follow-up detection uses regex pattern for Indonesian and English keywords combined with latestAnalysisContext.ticker+score check. Context indicator shows below composer when ticker context is active. All inline JS passes syntax validation via new Function().
